Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team liked what we saw. We're lining up a short, focused POC to validate latency and throughput under a realistic burst profile and have a couple of asks around trial credits / time-limited top-ups.

Summary of the run we want to execute:
- Window: Nov 8, 09:00 PST start, ~3 hours run (can extend if needed)
- Profile: ramp to 600 concurrent sessions, peak QPS ~900 (bursts up to 1,200 for short spikes)
- Avg tokens per request: ~120 (prompt + expected response), seq len target ~256 tokens max
- Models: we'll use the open 13B variant you recommended (we'll confirm exact id once you tell us which variant to pin)

What we need from Redwood:
1) A short-term, promotional credit allocation (or trial extension) that covers the above run — estimate attached.
2) A hard cap and TTL so we don't accidentally run up charges outside the window.
3) Any guidance on routing/fallback to smaller models if capacity is constrained.

I've attached our load plan (acme_poc_load_plan.csv) and a short benchmarking spec. Can you let me know whether Redwood can provision a time-limited credit top-up or trial extension for this specific burst test? If so, what info you need from our side (exact model id, start/end times, billing contact).

Thanks — Drew

Drew —

Appreciate the clear plan and the attachment. This is the kind of profile our hosted infra is built to exercise. A few quick clarifying questions before I loop in approvals:
- Can you confirm the exact model id you plan to pin? (e.g., rw-13b-fast or similar). Different variants change cost/throughput.
- Do you anticipate sustained traffic at 900 QPS for the full 3 hours, or is it more of a ramp-and-burst scenario (your note indicates short spikes to 1,200 QPS)?

Preliminary read: for the numbers you sent, rough ballpark is ~$4k–$6k in hosted spend (including some buffer for bursts). I ran a quick calc and attached a usage_estimate.xlsx with token assumptions and two scenarios (sustained vs bursty).

We can offer a time-limited promotional credit to cover the run with the following constraints (pending Rishi's sign-off):
- Credit amount: configurable, we'll propose $5,000 as a starting point.
- TTL: credit active for a 72-hour window around the run (you pick start).
- Scope: Hosted API only (no Dedicated/Private billing).
- Controls: we'll apply an account-level cap and per-minute QPS ceiling to prevent runaway usage.

If you confirm model id and the exact start/end times, I'll ask Rishi to approve the promo top-up and we'll add the HubSpot record + link to the ticket. Also flagging Marissa for any commercial items (if you need a formal promo code/contract addendum).

Thanks — Alex

Alex / team —

I've reviewed the attached estimate and the run profile. Approve a promotional credit allocation with the following terms:
- Amount: $5,000 credit applied to Acme Inc (deal ACME-POC-2026).
- Effective window: 72 hours starting at the specified start time (please confirm exact start; if none provided we'll set it to Nov 8 09:00 PST).
- Operational caps: max QPS ceiling of 1,200, account-level spend cap equal to the credit ($5k).
- Platform scope: Hosted API only; no Private/Dedicated usage allowed under this credit.
- Telemetry/visibility: Redwood will enable detailed token-level tracing for the window and deliver a post-run usage report.

I'll attach the signed approval stub (promo_credit_approval.pdf) and ask Alex to create a HubSpot activity and schedule a quick 30-min ops sync if Acme wants it.
